# How many should I prep today so I waste less and still do not sell out?

> Free daily prep quantity optimizer for bakeries, cafes and food trucks: paste past daily sales, mark sell-out days, and get the prep per item that earns the most after waste, with oven-minute and cash limits. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
